description: Defines the CachingCertVerifier class which implements a certificate verification caching mechanism, including cache management, verification result storage, and observer pattern integration.

classes.name: CachingCertVerifier
classes.description: A certificate verifier that caches verification results to improve performance and reduce redundant verification calls.

classes.name: CachedResult
classes.description: Stores the result of a certificate verification, including error code and verification details.

classes.name: CacheValidityPeriod
classes.description: Represents the validity period of a cached verification result, based on system time.

classes.name: CacheExpirationFunctor
classes.description: Determines if a cached result is still valid based on current time and expiration.

methods.name: CachingCertVerifier
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the verifier with a given underlying verifier.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Performs certificate verification, utilizing cache if possible.

methods.name: SetConfig
methods.description: Sets configuration parameters for the verifier.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer to monitor verifier events.

methods.name: OnRequestFinished
methods.description: Handles completion of a verification request, updates cache, and invokes callback.

methods.name: OnCertVerifierChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in the underlying cert verifier.

methods.name: OnCertDBChanged
methods.description: Handles updates to the certificate database.

methods.name: GetCacheSize
methods.description: Returns current size of the cache (for testing).
